buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder/Firm/Agency must be legally registered under applicable Act and possess valid Labour License. 2. Bidder must have valid EPF, ESIC, GST and other statutory registrations. 3. Bidder should not have been blacklisted/debarred by any Government/Semi-Government organization during the last 03 years. 4. Bidder shall upload Registration Certificate, PAN, GST Registration, Labour License, EPF Registration, ESIC Registration and all statutory documents with the technical bid. 5. Bidder must submit Income Tax Returns (ITR) of the last 03 financial years. 6. Average annual turnover of the bidder should be minimum Rs. 1.00 Crore during the last 03 financial years. 7. Service provider must have an office in Rajasthan and documentary proof shall be submitted. 8. Bidder must submit EPF ECR paid challans. 9. Bidder must submit ESIC ECR paid challans. 10. Bidder must submit GST returns/challans. 11. Bidder must submit manpower list and employee details available on company roll. 12. Bidder must possess a valid Udyam Registration Certificate. 13. Eligible Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) and DPIIT-recognized Startups shall be exempt from Bid Security/EMD as per applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), subject to applicable eligibility conditions and online validation. 14. Bidder must have minimum 02 years experience in manpower outsourcing services. 15. The Bidder/Firm/Company must have documented working experience in all major categories/nature of services included in the scope of this bid. Experience limited to only 02 or 03 service categories shall not be considered sufficient for eligibility. 16. Preference shall be given to vendors having existing work experience in EMRS/Government Institutions. 17. Experience certificates from Government Department/Semi-Government/PSU shall be enclosed. 18. Traders shall not be eligible. Only service providers registered for manpower outsourcing services shall be eligible. 19. Workers shall be paid strictly as per applicable Minimum Wages notified by Government. 20. Contractor shall provide manpower with proper ID Cards and comply with all labour laws. 21. Medical fitness and police verification of deployed manpower shall be responsibility of contractor. 22. Bidder shall quote rates inclusive of EPF, ESIC, GST, Taxes, Insurance, Service Charges and all statutory liabilities. 23. Department shall not be responsible for any Government dues, taxes or liabilities of contractor. 24. Daily attendance of deployed manpower shall be maintained properly.
25. Incomplete bids or bids without required documents shall be rejected. .
